meta.what_this_is: What the named neveninstellingen actually do, for the entities large enough to matter in the money data.
meta.method: Hand-curated, not machine-extracted. Each entry carries the URL it was read from. The party reports name entities and amounts but almost never describe what the entity does, so the description has to come from the entity's own charter, year plan or site. Where the name alone settles it (secretariaat, huisvesting, jongerenorganisatie) the entry says so instead of pretending to a source.

certainty.sourced: read from the URL in bron_url
certainty.from_name: evident from the entity's own name; no source fetched

caveat_false_positives: Vereniging Forum voor Democratie and Vereniging GroenLinks are the parties themselves, not neveninstellingen. They appear in the extraction because the reports list them in the same block.
Verkiezingsfonds (SP) is an earmarked reserve (bestemmingsreserve), not an entity. It is a line on the balance sheet.
Stichting Renaissance Instituut waren and Vereniging Forum voor Democratie E are truncation artefacts of the extraction, not separate entities.

entities.entiteit: Stichting Wetenschappelijk Instituut voor het CDA
entities.functie: Independent think tank attached to the CDA. Long-term policy advice, asked and unasked, to CDA politicians at national and local level; contributes to election programmes; publishes its own quarterly, Christen Democratische Verkenningen.

Forum voor Democratie's scientific bureau. Research (for instance on the budgetary effects of immigration), public lectures, and the Renaissanceschool, the first of which opened in Almere in August 2022.

GroenLinks's scientific bureau. An independent think tank that develops green and left thought and the party's programme, brings academics and politicians together, and publishes the quarterly de Helling. Its international work sits in a separate legal entity, Bureau de Helling Democracy Development Abroad, since 1 January 2016.

DENK's scientific institute. The name is Latin for balance, which is DENK's stated programme. Conducts policy-scientific research, deliberately seeking out groups it calls hard to reach and under-represented in research, and works at the join of academia, professional practice and civic involvement. KvK 64441067.

The PvdA's foreign-affairs foundation: democratisation in the EU's neighbouring countries, a fairer Dutch and EU policy towards the Global South, and public debate on those themes in the Netherlands. Merged with IFG in September 2026 and renamed PRO International, which puts it under the same name as the merged party.

ANBI with no profit motive, set up to fund the work of Groep Omtzigt: policy and scientific vision development, digital and communication work, and local projects. Raises its money in gifts. Its policy plan was under revision after Pieter Omtzigt left national politics.

The CDA's party secretariat: the office that runs the party organisation. Also the payee for the party's state subsidy, so it appears in the recipient register under its own KvK rather than under the party's name.
Holds and runs the CDA's party premises, which is why its line is large and steady: property, not politics.
The CDA's youth wing (Christen-Democratisch Jongeren Appèl), one of the twelve youth organisations the dashboard counts for 2024.
